title.zh: 第一章：節奏與速度基礎
title.en: Chapter 1: The Basics of Rhythm and Tempo

definition.zh: 時值(Time value)表示各音符之間的相對長度。最常用的基本拍子記號是以四分音符(crotchet, ♩)為一拍，代表軍隊行進時整齊規律的一步。音符組成部分包括符頭(note-head)、符幹(stem)及符尾/符槓(tail/beam)。
definition.en: Time value indicates the relative duration of notes. The crotchet (♩) is the standard sign for a single beat, representing regular marching footsteps.

title.en: [Visual Diagram 1: Parts of a Music Note]

title.zh: 【視覺圖解 2：符幹與符尾的正確畫法】
title.en: [Visual Diagram 2: Correct Drawing of Stems and Tails]

explanation.zh: 符頭在第三線下方時符幹朝上居右；在第三線上方時符幹朝下居左；但單獨音符的符尾永遠在右側！
explanation.en: Note parts include the note-head, stem, and tail/beam. Stems go up on the right when below the middle line, and down on the left when on or above the middle line. Tails are always on the right.

title.zh: 【視覺圖解 3：音符時值比例與金字塔換算】

explanation.zh: 這個金字塔圖解顯示了不同音符之間的時值比例。你可以清楚地看到一個全音符等於多少個較小的音符。
explanation.en: This pyramid diagram shows the relative time values between different notes. You can clearly see how many smaller notes make up a whole note.

examples.zh:
• 時值比例：1個全音符(Semibreve) ＝ 2個二分音符(Minim) ＝ 4個四分音符(Crotchet) ＝ 8個八分音符(Quaver) ＝ 16個十六分音符(Semiquaver) ＝ 32個三十二分音符(Demisemiquaver)。
• 八分音符有 1 條符尾/符槓；十六分音符有 2 條符尾/符槓；三十二分音符有 3 條符尾/符槓。
examples.en:
• 1 Semibreve = 2 Minims = 4 Crotchets = 8 Quavers = 16 Semiquavers = 32 Demisemiquavers.
• Quavers have 1 tail/beam; Semiquavers have 2 tails/beams; Demisemiquavers have 3 tails/beams.

tip.zh: 應試錦囊：符幹向上在右、向下在左，但符尾永遠在右側！計算時值時以最多出現的音符為基準。
tip.en: Stems go up on the right, down on the left; tails are ALWAYS on the right! Count using the smallest frequent note unit.

question.zh: 在音樂中，代表單一拍子（如軍隊行進步伐）最常用的基本音符是什麼？
question.en: Which note is most commonly used to represent a single beat (like marching footsteps)?

zh: 回想教材 1/1 開首軍隊行進『左、右、左、右』每一步的符號。
en: Think of the steady marching footsteps in Chapter 1/1.

explanation.zh: 四分音符 (Crotchet, ♩) 是最常代表一拍的基本音符。
explanation.en: The crotchet (♩) is the standard basic symbol for a single beat.

question.zh: 一個四分音符 (Crotchet) 的時值相等於多少個十六分音符 (Semiquavers)？
question.en: How many semiquavers equal one crotchet?

zh: 1個四分音符等於2個八分音符，每個八分音符又分為2個十六分音符。
en: 1 crotchet = 2 quavers, and each quaver = 2 semiquavers.

explanation.zh: 1個四分音符等於 4 個十六分音符（常以雙符槓連接）。
explanation.en: One crotchet equals four semiquavers (joined by a double beam).

name.zh: 1/2 小節線與拍子記號 (Bar-lines & Time signatures)

definition.zh: 小節線(Bar-lines)垂直貫穿五線譜，將拍子分為相等的小節(Bars)；樂曲結尾使用一幼一粗的終止線(Double bar-line)。拍子記號(Time signature)置於開首：分子代表每小節有幾拍，分母代表以什麼音符為一拍（2=二分音符，4=四分音符，8=八分音符）。C 代表 4/4 拍，而加一豎線的 ¢ 則代表 2/2 拍 (Alla breve)。
definition.en: Bar-lines are vertical lines that divide music into equal measures called bars. A double bar-line marks the end of a piece or section. The time signature placed at the beginning indicates how many beats are in each bar (top figure) and the note value of each beat (bottom figure: 2 = minim, 4 = crotchet, 8 = quaver). C stands for 4/4 (common time) and ¢ stands for 2/2 (alla breve).

examples.zh:
• 2/4 ＝ 每小節2個四分音符拍 ｜ 3/4 ＝ 每小節3個四分音符拍 ｜ 4/4 (或 C) ＝ 每小節4個四分音符拍。
• 3/2 ＝ 每小節3個二分音符拍 ｜ 3/8 ＝ 每小節3個八分音符拍。
examples.en:
• 2/4 = 2 crotchet beats per bar | 3/4 = 3 crotchet beats | 4/4 (or C) = 4 crotchet beats.
• 3/2 = 3 minim beats per bar | 3/8 = 3 quaver beats per bar.

tip.zh: 應試錦囊：分子代表「每小節拍數」，分母代表「拍子音符單位」（2=二分，4=四分，8=八分）。切勿混淆 C (4/4) 與 ¢ (2/2)！
tip.en: Top number = HOW MANY beats per bar; Bottom number = WHAT TYPE of note gets one beat (2=minim, 4=crotchet, 8=quaver).

question.zh: 在拍子記號中，上方的數字（分子）代表什麼？
question.en: In a time signature, what does the top figure show?

options.en: How many beats there are in a bar
The note value of the beat

zh: 上方的數字數算小節內的拍子數量。
en: Top = quantity of beats; Bottom = quality/type of beat.

explanation.zh: 拍號上方數字（分子）顯示每小節包含的拍數。
explanation.en: The top number indicates the number of beats per bar.

question.zh: 拍號符號 ¢ (Alla breve) 代表什麼拍子？
question.en: What does the time signature symbol ¢ (alla breve) mean?

options.zh: 2/2 拍（每小節兩個二分音符拍）
options.en: 2/2 time (two minim beats in a bar)

zh: C 是 4/4 拍，中間加一豎線的 ¢ 代表以二分音符為一拍的 2/2 拍。
en: C = 4/4; C with a vertical stroke through it (¢) halves the beat count to 2/2.

explanation.en: ¢ (alla breve) means 2/2 time (two minim beats per bar).

definition.zh: 拍子進行的快慢稱為「速度」(Tempo)。節拍器標記（如 M.M. ♩ = 120，M.M. 代表 Maelzel's Metronome 麥爾策節拍器）能精確指示每分鐘演奏多少拍。此外亦常使用意大利文術語標示速度（如 Largo 廣板/慢、Andante 行板、Allegro 快板）。
definition.en: The speed of the beats is called Tempo. A metronome mark (e.g. M.M. ♩ = 120, where M.M. stands for Maelzel's Metronome) shows precisely how many beats occur in one minute. Italian words are also commonly used to indicate speed and mood (e.g. Largo = slow, Andante = at a walking pace, Allegro = fast and lively).

examples.zh:
• ♩ = 60 代表每分鐘有 60 個四分音符拍（即每秒 1 拍）。
• ♩ = 120 代表每分鐘有 120 個四分音符拍（速度加快一倍）。
examples.en:
• ♩ = 60 means 60 crotchet beats per minute (1 beat per second).
• ♩ = 120 means 120 crotchet beats per minute (twice as fast).

tip.zh: 應試錦囊：M.M. 標記指「每分鐘拍數」，數字越大代表速度越快！
tip.en: M.M. = Maelzel's Metronome. Larger number = faster tempo!

question.zh: 樂曲開首標示 ♩ = 100 代表什麼意思？
question.en: What does the marking ♩ = 100 at the start of a piece indicate?

options.zh: 每分鐘奏 100 個四分音符拍

zh: 這是節拍器標記，用來計算一分鐘內的拍數。
en: It is a metronome mark measuring beats per minute.

explanation.zh: ♩ = 100 指示速度為每分鐘 100 個四分音符拍。
explanation.en: ♩ = 100 specifies a tempo of 100 crotchet beats per minute.

question.zh: 音樂術語『Tempo』的意思是什麼？
question.en: What does the term 'Tempo' mean in music?

zh: Tempo 指拍子進行的快慢速度。

explanation.en: Tempo means the speed of the beats in music.

definition.zh: 「節奏」(Rhythm) 與「速度」(Tempo) 截然不同。即使將一首熟悉的旋律拍打得快一些或慢一些（改變了速度），其由不同長短時值與強弱重音所組成的圖案結構——即「節奏」——依然保持不變。
definition.en: Rhythm is not the same as tempo. Even if a familiar tune is tapped out faster or slower (changing its tempo), its rhythm — the pattern formed by sounds of varying lengths and accents — remains unchanged.

examples.zh: • 無論將國歌或生日歌拍打得快或慢，改變的只是「速度」(Tempo)，但其音符長短與重音組合而成的「節奏」(Rhythm) 完全不變。
examples.en: • Tapping 'God Save the Queen' fast or slow changes its TEMPO, but the RHYTHM pattern (♩ ♩ ♩ | ♩. ♪ ♩) stays identical.

tip.zh: 應試錦囊：Tempo 是「快慢速度」，Rhythm 是「長短與重音的組合圖案」，切勿混淆！
tip.en: Tempo = Speed (fast/slow); Rhythm = Pattern of note lengths and accents.

question.zh: 如果你將一首熟悉的曲調拍打得更快或更慢，什麼東西會保持不變？
question.en: If you tap a familiar tune more quickly or more slowly, what stays the same?

zh: 改變快慢只會改變速度，不會改變音符長短比例的節奏圖案。
en: Changing pace changes tempo, not the duration pattern.

explanation.zh: 旋律的節奏（音符長短與重音圖案）保持不變。
explanation.en: The rhythm (pattern of note lengths and accents) remains the same.

question.zh: 節奏 (Rhythm) 與速度 (Tempo) 有何分別？
question.en: What is the difference between rhythm and tempo?

options.zh: 節奏是音符長短與重音的組合圖案；速度是拍子的快慢
options.en: Rhythm is the pattern of note lengths and accents; tempo is the speed of the beats
They mean the exact same thing

options.zh: 節奏是快慢；速度是音量
options.en: Rhythm is speed; tempo is loudness
Tempo is only used in slow music

zh: 溫習 1/4 節奏與速度的定義區別。
en: Review Section 1/4 on how rhythm and tempo differ.

explanation.zh: 節奏指長短與重音圖案；速度則指快慢。
explanation.en: Rhythm refers to patterns of duration and accent; tempo refers to speed.
